description: This file defines a function to create and retrieve a singleton instance of a Supabase client, configured with environment variables. It supports both browser and server environments, ensuring a single client instance is used throughout the application.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Returns a singleton Supabase client instance configured with environment variables. Throws an error if required configuration is missing. Uses memoization for browser environments to prevent multiple instances.
